[h1]RimMind - Bridge: RimTalk (v2.0)[/h1] Speech bubble pipeline harmonization and bidirectional cognitive context bridge between the RimMind suite and the RimTalk mod. Unifies overhead dialogue rendering, prevents duplicate conversation triggers, and injects RimMind's Big-Five personality profiles, memories, advisor logs, and storyteller state into RimTalk prompts.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]Zero Hard-Dependency Reflection Shim ([code]RimTalkApiShim[/code])[/b]: Integrates with RimTalk via safe reflection and public data seams, remaining safely inert when RimTalk is not installed. Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]Bidirectional Cognitive Data Flow[/b]: Pushes RimMind personality, memory, advisor, and storyteller variables into RimTalk while pulling RimTalk conversation history back into RimMind's context engine. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Dialogue Mutual Exclusion Gating[/b] - Automatically skips overlapping [code]RimMind-Dialogue[/code] triggers (chitchat, automatic dialogue, player input) when RimTalk is active so two speech bubble systems never clash. [*][b]Context Push (RimMind to RimTalk)[/b] - Registers RimMind data as RimTalk prompt variables ([code]rimmind_personality[/code], [code]rimmind_storyteller[/code], [code]rimmind_memory[/code], [code]rimmind_shaping[/code], [code]rimmind_advisor_log[/code], [code]rimmind_persona_desc[/code], [code]rimmind_persona_work[/code], [code]rimmind_persona_social[/code], [code]rimmind_persona_narrative[/code]). [*][b]Hook Context Enhancement[/b] - Optionally appends RimMind personality descriptions and psychological narratives directly into RimTalk's Traits and Mood context hooks. [*][b]Dialogue History Pull (RimTalk to RimMind)[/b] - Registers RimTalk's conversation history as the [code]rimtalk_history[/code] context provider in [code]RimMind-Core[/code], allowing Advisor, Personality, and Storyteller to reference RimTalk conversations. [/list]

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: What is the difference between Context Push and Context Pull?[/b] A: [b]Push[/b] exposes RimMind's personality, advisor, and storyteller data inside RimTalk prompts so RimTalk lines stay true to each colonist's psychology. [b]Pull[/b] imports RimTalk conversations into RimMind so Advisor and Memory know what colonists discussed.
[b]Q: Can I use this mod when RimTalk is disabled?[/b] A: Yes. It automatically detects whether RimTalk is active and disables all hooks and gating if RimTalk is not loaded.
